name: vulns
description: The Vulnerability Tracker's domain: assets, findings and the remediation audit trail, saved as JSON in the app's data home. Every page plugin injects it.
mount: a row `- id: vulns` / `name: vulns` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `vulns` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default vulnerability-tracker.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
